description: admiral-io org-wide Renovate preset. Per-repo configs extend this via {"extends": ["local>admiral-io/.github"]}.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: admiral SDK packages — bump on any release, no delay (we control them)
Admiral container images (ghcr.io) — bump on any release
GitHub Actions — group bumps, pin to SHA, keep version comment

admiral-protos: do not bump go-yit. It's pinned via replace directive to work around a yaml.v3/v4 type conflict in vmware-labs/yaml-jsonpath. Remove this rule when yaml-jsonpath publishes a yaml/v4-compatible release.
Patch/minor dev deps in protos tooling — group and let through quickly
